Pakistan would look to clean up the English pacers as quickly as possible to maintain a healthy lead. So let's hope we have another entertaining day of cricket. The match looks evenly poised currently, with no team having a firm upper hand.

Welcome everyone, we are about to start the coverage of the third day in some while. Yesterday saw a fifer taken by the Pakistani leggie Yasir Shah, who again proved a big hurdle for the English middle order. Cook played a well paced half century with some contributions from Root and Woakes.
...DAY 3, SESSION 1...

Stealing the show was leggie Yasir Shah, whose five-fer, post the first session, took down one batsman after the other. The other bowlers were less impressive despite putting in their concerted efforts. It was a frustrating time for Mohammad Amir who missed out on Cook's wicket twice due to poor fielding. The fielders were lackluster and let several chances slip through. Overall the game is perfectly poised at the moment and day 3 should be another exciting one! Will we see England squeezing the deficit or will the Pakistani bowlers bowl them out in the morning session itself? Join us tomorrow at 1530 IST for all the action. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Root's wicket fell just before the first session ended but Cook held on for much longer. The middle order couldn't do much but the lower middle order did the job. The wicketkeeper batsman Bairstow played aggressively but got out soon. Moeen Ali and Chris Woakes shared a valuable stand of 39 runs for the 7th wicket and dealt with the visitors' bowling attack.

That ends day 2 of the first Test between England and Pakistan. It is quite evident that the visitors have the upper hand at this mid-way stage. In the morning, England bowled Pakistan out under 350 but then got off to a shaky start as they lost Hales early on. Cook caught a lucky break as he was dropped and he and Root stabilised the innings with an aggressive 110-run stand.

Approximately 40 overs are remaining in the day and only time will tell how much can the tourists bowl. For now will it will be the leggie YASIR SHAH to start off with the bowling proceedings. Let's play!!!
DAY 2... SESSION 3...

Shah was the catalyst to the downfall of England's top order, taking all three wickets in the session. His spin bowling frustrated the Englishmen and checked the flow of runs. It was a trying session for Mohammad Amir as he was denied the wicket of Cook due to some poor fielding. Join us for the final session in a little while.

That concludes another balanced session at Lord's. The second session resumed with Root and Cook in firm control. Cook suffered a scare in the first session with a dropped catch but recovered well to run up  a 110-run stand with Root. However, he was only able to do so as Pakistan's inept fielding allowed him yet another chance in the 2nd session. He remains in control still and sees his side through to the 3rd session. Root put up 48 runs but narrowly fell short of his half century after Hafeez redeemed himself by taking the catch. Vince and Ballance made brief cameos but were dismissed soon after.

FOUR! He finally nails it! Length ball outside off, Cook plays the square cut and the ball races to the backward point boundary. Alastair Cook goes past Sunil Gavaskar to become the highest Test opener in cricket history!
BEATEN! Length ball outside off and tempting Cook again. Cook falls for it and attempts a drive but misses it.
Good length delivery around off, the ball angles in and hits Cook on the pads.
Shorter ball outside off, Cook looks to cut it but misjudges the length.
Landed outside off, played to the point region.
Floated on off, worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, pushed to the covers.
Full on the stumps, Root steps forward and blocks it back.
100-run stand between Cook and Root.
On the leg side, flicked the ball off the pads for a single.
Tossed up on the pads, Cook sweeps it to the leg side.
YASIR SHAH is back on.
Drinks time!
Length ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball swings wide away and Root shoulders his arms.
Length ball outside off, Root pushes it off the front foot to the covers.
Fuller ball on middle, Cook flicks it through the covers for a single.
Cook rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

DROPPED! A second life for Cook! Length ball outside off, Cook looks to push it to the off side but gets a slight edge and the ball goes to the keeper. It is an easy catch but Sarfraz fumbles it. Same batsman, same bowler. Misbah comes up and gives him a conciliatory pat on the shoulder. One can only imagine how frustrating it must be for Amir.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back into the attack!
Angles a length delivery on middle, Root gets back and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length and outside off, Root punches it towards the man at covers.
Full and angled on middle, Cook flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish on off, pushed towards covers.

Fuller length delivery on off, Cook presses forward and drives past the man at covers. It looked like it will reach the fence before the fielder came across to his left and stopped it with a dive just inside the boundary line. A couple of runs taken.
Good length delivery on off, Cook decides it's good if he allows it to go through.
On the stumps, Cook gets inside edge onto the pads as he attempts to block it.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle, worked to square leg for a single.
Looped in on off, blocked with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated in outside off, Cook cuts it to backward point but the ball is stopped in its tracks.
In the channel outside off, Root shoulders his arms to that one.
Full length delivery on off, Cook shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in the channel on off, Root driven straight to the man at mid off.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single. 100 up for England!
Full and angled on middle, Root works it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and outside off, Root punches it back to the bowler.
Full and around middle, Cook flicks it past the man at short leg.
Cook gets forward and flicks it towards short fine leg.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot towards covers.
Full and around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, Cook defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Tossed up around off, driven through covers for a single.
Cook gets behind the line and defends it down.
Outside off, Cook has nothing to do with this one.
Full ball on off, Cook drives it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven towards covers.
49th Test fifty for ALASTAIR COOK.

FOUR! Shot, that! Beautifully played by Captain Cook! Short of a length delivery on off, width given as well. Cook stays inside the crease and whacks it through point for a blazing boundary. Superb stroke to bring up the 50.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Root shoulders his arms.
Loopy delivery around off, Root camps back and punches it towards covers.
Short on middle, coming in. Cook gets back and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, Cook defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Tossed up around off, Cook gets forward and defends it down.
Starts with a loopy delivery around middle, Root gets forward and nudges it off the inside half of the bat towards backward square leg for a single.
YASIR SHAH to roll his arm!
Well bowled. Yorker outside off, Cook grounds the ball to the off side.
Good length ball around off, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! Crunched! Length ball outside off, Cook square cuts it through point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Cook looks to defend it and nearly gets an edge as the ball swings away.
Shorter ball just outside off, Root gets on the back foot and punches it to covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, punched to the off side.
Fuller on off, 86.8 mph, pushed back to the bowler. A slight misfield allows the batsmen to take a single and Root to keep the strike.
Good length ball outside off, the ball angles away and Root lets it through.
Length ball on the stumps, Root clips it through mid-wicket for a brace. A well considered shot!
Fuller outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Full around off, driven to mid off.
Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Length ball around off, defended to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Cook looks to defend it but misjudges the line completely and the ball goes to the keeper.
Length ball on middle and off, Root flicks it to square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Root positions himself in front of the stumps and defends it to the off side. He looks very relaxed at the crease.
Short around off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, angling away, Root leaves it alone.
RAHAT ALI is back into the attack!
Full on off, pushed back to Riaz.
FOUR! Fullish ball around off, Cook steps forward and punches it down the ground. Rahat Ali half-heartedly chases it but loses the battle as the ball crosses the fence.
Good length delivery outside off and this time swinging in, Cook leaves it.
Length ball and just a tad outside off, a front foot defense to mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed to the covers.
No ball. Length ball outside off, defended to the off side. The bowler oversteps and the umpire signals a no ball.
Shorter ball around off, punched off the back foot to point for a single.
Good length delivery wide outside off, Cook lets it through.
Fuller on the pads, Root looks to block it and gets and outside edge. The batsmen run a single.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point.
Good length delivery on middle and off, worked to the leg side.
Length ball around off, 86.4 mph, defended down the pitch.
Length ball wide outside off, Cook rocks onto the back foot and punches it to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Length ball outside off and swinging away again, Root gets on the back foot and slashes the ball over point for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, swinging away wildly, Root shoulders his arms.
Fuller ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball around off and swinging away, wisely left alone.
Short ball on middle, Root ducks to avoid it and smiles sheepishly after.
Length ball outside off, Root punches it off the back foot to the covers.
Length ball outside off, left alone. Maiden for Amir.
Back of the length outside off, Cook looks to cut it to the off side but gets a bottom edge.
Outside off, Cook lets that one through.
Close one! Length ball outside off, Cook plays it with soft hands, edging it to the slips and narrowly avoiding getting caught.
Good length delivery wide outside off, angling away, left alone.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
MOHAMMAD AMIR will bowl from the other end!
Length delivery on the leg stump, Root flicks it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Fullish outside off, Cook pushes it off the front foot towards point for one.
Fuller length delivery on off, Cook gets forward and defends it down.
Angles a length delivery on off, Cook makes a watchful leave.
Length delivery outside off, Cook shoulders his arms to that one.
Runs straightaway! Good length delivery on off, Root gets back and dabs it towards third man. Masood from backward point gives it a chase and keeps them down to three runs.
Welcome back for the second session. ALASTAIR COOK and JOE ROOT will continue from where they left off. WAHAB RIAZ to steam in first up. Let's play!!!
DAY 2... SESSION 2...

England started poorly with the bat as Alex Hales was dismissed by Rahat Ali. Cook and Root then played sensibly and put the bad balls for boundaries. They kept the score board ticking at a good pace. Cook, however got lucky as he was given a huge reprieve by Hafeez and since then no real chance came Pakistan's way. The duo have already threaded a 50-run stand and post lunch would be looking to get going this way. Pakistan pacers bowled well but just couldn't get what they wanted apart from an early success. Will we see them bowling with venom in the next session? Do join us in a short while.

An eventful morning session comes to an end on day 2. England just needed 12.2 overs to bundle out Pakistan and not letting them get to the 350-run mark. It was Chris Woakes in particular who took the advantage of the overcast conditions and registered his career-best figures with a 6-fer. Broad accompanied him well, while the rest weren't needed to trouble the lower middle order of the visitors.
Angled in from length, Cook shoulders his arms. AND THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY TWO.
Pitching outside off, angling towards the body of Cook, he let's it go.
Outside off, ball held it's line, Cook leaves it happily.
Length ball angling towards the stumps, Root plays it on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length ball, Root gets back in his crease and directs the ball towards the third man region past the slip fielders.
Angling in from around, Root defends it off the front foot.
Length delivery, Cook happy to not have a go at it.
Length ball outside off, Cook shoulders his arms.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Cook is in two minds, to leave it or play it, but ends up bootom edging it for a boundary towards the third man region.
Outside off by Riaz, Cook leaves it alone.
On a length and outside off, Cook allows it to go through to the keeper.
First bowling change then, WAHAB RIAZ is brought into the attack!
Good length delivery on off, Root gets back and punches it back to the bowler. A dot ball to end the over!
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Cook gets right behind the line and defends it down.
Good length and outside off, punched towards the off side.
Very full and around off, driven towards mid off.

FOUR! Edgy boundary! Cook is carrying some luck here! Amir hurls a full length delivery on off, that shapes away after landing. Cook presses forward to defend but gets an outside edge which doesn't carry to the slip cordon and instead goes through the second and third slip fielder for a boundary towards third man. Amir smiles and then starts to walk back.
Ali bangs it short again, Root ducks under it and a good take by Sarfraz behind the stumps.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Root arches back to evade it.
Good length ball served outside off, Root ignores.

FOUR! Poor ball and got the treatment it needed! Full and angled on the pads, Root walks across and nudges it off the meat of the bat through mid-wicket for back-to-back boundaries. Brings up the 50 for England as well!

FOUR! Down the ground! This is Root special! Fuller length delivery, asking to be driven and Root obliges it. Transfers his weight on the front foot and drives it past the man at mid off for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, defended off the back foot gently.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! This is really frustrating for a bowler! A catch is dropped on the previous ball and then he's being hit for a boundary! Amir bowls it on the pads, Cook shuffles a bit and works it through square leg for a boundary.

In the air... dropped! What have you done Hafeez? That should have been taken. Amir bowls a length delivery, little bit of movement there. Cook feels for it and as a result gets a thick outside edge towards first slip where the Pakistani opener Hafeez drops a sitter. How much will this cost?
Slight full and shaping away a bit. Cook prods forward and defends it down.
Good length delivery on off, Cook gets back and punches it straight to the man at covers.
Fuller and around off, defended off the front foot.
Brilliant stop! Fuller length delivery on off, driven towards covers where it is stopped by the fielder with a dive to his right. They wanted a single but won't get there.
Outside off, left alone.

Good length delivery on off, Root looks to punch but gets it off the outside part of the bat on a bounce to the gully fielder. He then has a shy at the striker's end and it hits. The ball ricochets towards mid-wicket where Yasir Shah dives full length to stop the overthrows. Good back-up done there!
FOUR! Sweet! On a length and outside off, Root gets on the back foot and punches it through the gap at covers for a boundary. That was some oozing class from the English run machine!
Angles a short ball on middle, Cook tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length delivery on off, Root pushes it towards covers for a single.
Length ball, Root nudges it to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Length ball pitched on off, Root puts it away with a jab through point. Misfielding by Yasir Shah earns England a boundary.
Taking the ball away from the stumps, Root opts to not have a go at it.
Chris Woakes is seen going to nets for some batting practice now after having a wonderful time with the ball. The crowd is appreciating the effort as well. Dedicated youngster?
Angling away from the batsman, Root shoulders his arms.
Replica of the previous delivery, Root leaves it again.
Outside off, Root leaves it for Sarfraz to collect.
On the middle stump, Cook blocks it on mid on.
FOUR! Amazing wrist work! Full on his pads, Cook puts it away through square leg to add four runs to the total.
FOUR! Fuller delivery on the middle, Cook flicks it to perfection for a boundary towards the mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Cook opens the face of his bat and works it past gully for a boundary towards the third man region.
Pitched on the leg stump and going outside leg, Cook tries to work it but is not successful.
Pitched on the off stump, going away, Root blocks it on the off side.
Full and outside off, Root let's it go
Anngling away, Root pushes it to the point fielder.
Going away from the batsman, Root leaves it.
On the pads, Cook flicks it for three runs towards the mid wicket region. Good running.
FOUR! Length ball, Cook tries to push it but edges it for a boundary towards third man.
JOE ROOT is the new man in!

OUT! Pitched on length and angling away from the batsman, Hales tries to push it, the ball catches the outside edge of his bat and flies to third slip where Azhar is there to take the catch. Breakthrough for Pakistan!
Again a full inswinging delivery, Hales blocks it on the leg side.
Full inswinging delivery, Hales plays it towards mid on.
Length ball pitched on middle, catches leading edge of Hales' bat towards covers.
Niping back in from the good length, Hales defends it nicely.
Trying to cut a length delivery, Cook inside edges it towards fine leg for a single.
RAHAT ALI will share the new cherry from the other end!
Angling away from the batsman, Hales blocks it on the off side.
Length ball angling outside off, Hales defends it.
Short ball, Hales jabs it for a couple towards the mid-wicket region.
FOUR! Beautiful inswinging delivery by Amir, Hales flicks it for a boundary through square leg. Amazing wrist work.
Short of a length, directed towards the body, Hales pushes it down.
First ball after 6 years absence in the Test is a length ball outside off with a hint of a swing, Cook pushes it for a single towards covers..
